name: component-ui-collection
description: Framework-free catalog for reusable HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind UI components.

scripts.predev: pnpm run validate:english && pnpm run build:index
scripts.build: pnpm run validate:english && pnpm run validate:components && pnpm run build:index && vite build && node scripts/publish-components.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run validate:english && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e
